D1-M01: The Spah's charges destroyed two of the Procession's four Cultist Troopers in Round 2, and from then on the Spah held the centre and the left; a 10 RP Sagdid Hound-Keepers scored 9.8 VP on the left. The Procession killed 80 RP to the 30 it lost, but from Round 4 its only unit on an objective was The Pontifex of Acedia.
D1-M02: The Warhost's Corporaider Squads and Black Huskarls stood on all three objectives in Round 1, before the Cohort reached any, then charged the Legionnaire Squads down one by one. Corporaider Squad 1 held the right all battle for 13.4 VP; the Cohort lost six units (162 RP) to the Warhost's one (28 RP).
D1-M03: Caesar and the Palatine Custos (Mounted), now OC 2 a model, took the centre from Round 3 and held it. But the Convent's ten units held both flanks, and a 10 RP Covenant Levies from Troop Requisition walked onto the empty right and held it for three rounds (8.3 VP). The first playing ended 32-4; this one 34-23.
D1-M04: The Etna's Ferricants held the centre from Round 2 and retook the left in Round 5, but no Etna unit ever went to the right, where the House of Glass Arcanist - one 5 HP model - scored 2 VP a round for four rounds. IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS paid the Fencibles' ten units 9 VP, and the battle went to them by 4.
D1-M05: The Hundred led 21-12 after Round 3 with cheap Veche Levies on the centre and the left, then lost four OC units and scored 3 VP in the last three rounds. The Peijaiset Wardens held the right in every scored round (12.1 VP); the round cap stopped the Song at 29 in Round 5, and the Wardens' charge for INTO THE FRAY ended it in Round 6.
D1-M06: The Oath took all three objectives in Round 1 and led 18-7 after Round 2, then lost Tadeusz Kosciuszko, the Silesian Hammerguards and all three Commonwealth Fusiliers (156 RP, to the Legion's 10). The Legion held the left with Covenant Levies 3 and, from Round 4, the centre with the Archistrategos' pair; the Oath's two Consecrated Hussars could not hold three objectives.
D1-M07: In Round 2 the Pack charged six times: all three Muqatila squads fell back and all three failed the test, and the Weretiger Stalkers' kill of Muqatila Troopers 1 and the Rammal Geomancer paid ASSASSINATION and DEBT OF BLOOD in a 10 VP round. Saladin took the centre back in Round 4, but Sword of Allah completed no secondary to the Pack's 9 VP of them.
D1-M08: The Bailiffs planted RAISE THE STANDARD in the enemy half, scored its full 10 by Round 4 and led 27-23 after Round 5. Then their Cultist holders failed Morale every round - SUPPRESSED at OC 0, they fed COORDINATED SUPPRESSION - and Legio XIII's last round hit the 10 VP cap while the Bailiffs scored nothing.
D1-M09: The Host's ten units scored IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS to its 10 VP limit and held two objectives in Rounds 3 and 4, and the Blackflint Archers shot down the Parish Militia and the Knight-Ascendants. The Knights' GARRISON DUTY, worth 4 VP to them the first time, scored 0: every Knights unit on an objective moved, attacked or counterattacked every round. The first playing went the other way, 30-10.
D1-M10: The Rade held all three objectives in Rounds 1 and 2 and led 19-2. The Vigil came back with a capped 10 VP Round 4 that killed four Rade units, and the Redcap Reivers' kill on the centre in Round 6 completed KING OF THE HILL and ended it.
D1-M11: The Sineaters charged Etxe Riflemen 3 off the centre in Round 2 and destroyed it, and from Round 3 they held all three objectives. The Oak destroyed no enemy unit all battle (0 RP to 113), so ERADICATE THE FOE never paid, and it scored nothing after Round 2.
D1-M12: It stood 15-17 after Round 3. Then the Knights of Tehom took the centre, the Evil-Eye Serpent killed the Judgement's HQ and its last holders, and three requisitioned Cultist squads kept the flanks. The Judgement destroyed two Cultist squads (20 RP to 134) and completed no secondary. The first playing went the other way, 31-22.
D1-M13: Mouseion Contingent led 17-11 after two rounds by spreading over all three objectives: the Hephaestian Tripod held the east unopposed (10.8 VP for 20 RP), and League Hoplite 1 survived every round it was named for FORLORN HOPE. The Protectores won the fighting from Round 3 (160 RP destroyed for 20, Heron of Alexandria killed for ASSASSINATION) and scored the 10 VP maximum in Round 4, but finished on 28, two short of the 30 VP target.
D1-M14: The Veiled Court took Uruk's Temple Levy away: Whispers of Forbidden Pleasure seized Temple Levy 2 and then 3 for a round each, and Temptation of Earthly Delight turned Temple Levy 1 for good in Round 3. From Round 3 the Court held all three objectives and scored the 10 VP maximum three rounds running; Uruk scored only FORLORN HOPE after Round 2.
D1-M15: The Chonae Wing's six Covenant Levies squads out-held the Cossacks' fast cavalry, taking all three objectives in Round 2 and scoring 10 VP in Rounds 2 and 4. The Bulava lost RAISE THE STANDARD in Round 1, when Michaelite Brethren 2 walked onto the standard, and scored only in Round 3. Terek Shashka Riders 1 did the most damage on the table (38).
D1-M16: The Golden Tumen scored the 10 VP maximum in each of three rounds, the fastest win the cap allows: its Tamga-Bound Troops out-numbered the dead on every objective, the Round 3 ones by just 1 and 2 OC. The March lost its one hard squad, the Akhguard, attacking Genghis Khan in Round 2, and never scored BLEED THEM WHITE.
D1-M17: The Glandore Breakers' Sidhe took all three objectives in the first move and led 17-2 after two rounds. The Winter Host won Rounds 4 and 5, 13-4 - ASSASSINATION on Morrigan's Chosen, and Rurik with the Rynda Guard holding the west - but never held more than one objective, and the Breakers closed it with the 10 VP maximum in Round 6.
D1-M18: The Murderhost's eight-unit charge in Round 2 broke all three Ashigaru squads off their ground; it held the centre every round and the east in five of six, with Cultist Zealots 1 (10 RP) doing 31 damage, 4 kills and ASSASSINATION. Kishomon stayed in touch through an Armored Gashadokuro that held the west from Round 2 without ever acting (17.5 VP) and STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION (9 VP).
D1-M19: Cappadocian Riders held the 3 VP centre in each of Rounds 1-4 (12 of their 32 VP) with Dragoon Brethren as the anchor, and the Brethren shot Horns of Hattin's first Troop Requisition dead the round it arrived. In Round 5 Crimson Knights 2, under Agnus Dei, destroyed Khassakiyya Guard 1 and the west flipped: the Riders passed 30 although Horns of Hattin maxed LEAD FROM THE FRONT at 10.
D1-M20: Silver Arrow Brethren 1 and 2 destroyed four of Alea Iacta's seven starting units in two rounds - the Champion of Mars, the Speculatores and both Legionnaire Squads - and Brethren 2 shot Alea Iacta's HQ dead in Round 5. Ironthunder Vanguard 2 held the centre for three rounds, but Popinjay Guild held the east all six. The first playing went the other way, 6-32.
D1-M21: Flamewrought Company held the centre every round and destroyed nine Belfry Battery units (177 RP) for two. Javidan Immortals 1 and Ardashir broke the Knight-Apostle Squad in Round 2; cheap Sagdid Hound-Keepers and Shieldbearers then took every objective while the gun line died. The Battery held no objective after Round 2.
D1-M22: Soudarion Cortege took all three objectives in Round 1 and held at least two every round. Sepulchre Guard 2 with Lazarite Prelate 2 held the west for three rounds and killed Muqatila Troopers 2 and Naqib 2 for MAN OF THE HOUR. The 10 VP round cap withheld 10 VP from the Cortege in Rounds 3 and 4, and it still finished in Round 4. The first playing went the other way, 25-33.
D1-M23: Longwu Army's two Vermillion Rocket Batteries did 84 damage (Battery 2 alone 62, the most of any unit on the Day's last six) and burned away every Cultist and Lucent screen. Ten Commandery Bannermen squads held the objectives and scored IMPENETRABLE FORTRESS every round: Longwu hit the 10 VP cap in Rounds 2-4. Tithe of Torment fed the Goetic Ophanim three Fractured Horizons for 37 damage, but three CHARACTERS could not out-OC the Bannermen.
D1-M24: Scorpion Shields won Round 1 and lost the battle in Round 2: a 3 CP Countercharge sent the Golgothic Paladins into the Marshal pair, Praetorian Tribune 1 and Praetorian Strikers 1, and destroyed both. From Round 3 the Miserere Column's Levies held all three objectives. Scorpion Shields destroyed no enemy unit all battle and lost five (170 RP).
